mapper.select: SELECT v.target_type AS targetType, v.target_id AS targetId, v.name, v.category, v.is_sold_out AS isSoldOut, v.image_url AS imageUrl FROM vw_soldout_catalog v ORDER BY v.target_type, v.category, v.name
mapper.update: UPDATE menu SET sold_out = #{isSoldOut} WHERE id = #{targetId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE ingredient SET sold_out = #{isSoldOut} WHERE id = #{targetId}
UPDATE opt_item SET sold_out = #{isSoldOut} WHERE id = #{targetId}
